cartographer.declared_question: Which execution assumptions belong inside a generative plate, and which should remain replaceable properties of a reader?
cartographer.inquiry_basis: Existing WebAssembly proposals REL-P-000010 and REL-P-000011 and exact FN-33.

sources_checked.attribution: W3C WebAssembly Core Specification, sections Scope, Security Considerations, and Embedding.
source_facts: The core defines computational semantics but leaves environment-specific invocation and interaction to embedding interfaces.
Environmental capabilities are supplied through imported functions controlled by the embedder.
The embedding interface connects the host to the defined semantics.
sources_checked.inference: The portable-module precedent remains relevant to FN-33, but executing instructions is not the same as preserving an artwork's full encounter, assets, or authorized edition lineage.
sources_checked.uncertainty: Focused primary-document review only, not a module execution, browser interoperability test, security assessment, or claim about the entire specification. No endorsement or architectural equivalence is implied.

cartographer.access_note: A guessed split introduction path returned 404, while the canonical document exceeded the web reader's size limit. A direct read of the canonical W3C document succeeded; relevant scope, security, and embedding passages were extracted. Failed reads were not evidence and no failed candidate was published.
cartographer.no_proposal_reason: The existing proposal pair already states the portable-computation and replaceable-host distinction with explicit artistic and lineage limits. No duplicate node or edge was needed.
cartographer.handoff: Existing WebAssembly queue and focused source comparison handed to the Gardener.

reviewed: Current 12-node, 7-edge manifest and WebAssembly proposal pair
Exact FN-33, I-005, BN-006, A-005, BN-005, I-003, and the Kernel's verbs and laws
Catalog descriptions and related paths across portability, execution boundaries, and Dear Elsewhere's public prototype records

changes.decision: Make the public artifact record's browser dependency and external-source limits visible in catalog context.

evidence.locator: A compatible browser is still needed to perform the viewer, and external links may stop resolving.; They do not establish identity, rights, consent, or unbroken availability.

changes.rationale: The portable-export description is accurate, but this record lacked an explicit uncertainty field. Its own Keeping the work section gives concrete limits a reader should encounter beside the export promise. This clarifies metadata without changing source, attribution, lifecycle, or relation claims.

retained_decisions: Keep portable computation distinct from a complete visual or media encounter.
Keep included file bytes distinct from external references and browser capabilities.
Keep the dated prototype record distinct from a current runtime audit or completed interpersonal study.
Keep graph, review states, ratification history, and the finite selection unchanged.
gardener.decision_reason: One source-grounded context clarification was warranted. No graph repair, lifecycle change, or relational-change essay was needed. The review was bounded and does not claim full semantic inspection of every publication.

librarian.decision_reason: Read all 34 cumulative records and the same-run office outputs. Applied the Gardener's clarification to A-005, adding exact evidence, dated uncertainty, and two ordinary-language terms: compatible browser and external links may disappear. Existing title, summary, subjects, questions, related path, and model-proposed status remain unchanged. All 33 other records are retained. The Librarian performed no outward search.
